messages:
Maya: Quick design review — thinking about adding a p95 outline overlay on the per-route heatmap so people can see tail latency trends while sampling is enabled. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screens/heatmap-overlay.png
Alex: I like the idea. Concern: overlapping the density colors might make the line hard to read. Maybe a dashed line + glow halo? :thinking_face:
Janet: Accessibility flag — overlay needs >=4.5:1 contrast against the heatmap. Propose 6px stroke halo with reduced opacity instead of pure white stroke.
Sam: Interaction note — when toggling "Auto-sample" the overlay should recompute the displayed scale and briefly show a toast: "Sampling adjusted to preserve p95 visibility". Otherwise users will think the data jumped.
Alex: Also we should add keyboard shortcuts for the timepicker: left/right to nudge range by 5m, shift+arrow for 1h, and home/end to go to start/end of retention. Current widget misses these.
Maya: Copy tweak suggestion: instead of the terse "Adaptive sampling" label, use "Auto-sample to preserve p95" (shorter on hover tooltip: "Automatically adjusts sample rate to keep tail latency visible").
Janet: For small-multiples (compare routes) the p95 overlay must be per-panel scaled by default. If we force a global scale, small routes' tails are visually flattened and people get the wrong impression. Provide a "Sync Y-axis across panels" toggle (off by default).
Sam: Agree on per-panel scaling. Also propose a fallback visual when sample rate is low: dim the p95 line and show an inline badge: "low sample — p95 unreliable".
DesignBot: Quick style snippet suggestion: `
.p95-line{
  stroke-dasharray:4,4;
  stroke-width:2px;
  stroke-opacity:0.95;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25));
}
`
Maya: Tooltip microcopy idea when hovering a p95 point: "p95 latency: 320ms — sample rate 15% (lower sample = wider uncertainty)". Helps teams assess confidence without leaving the chart.
Alex: Edge case: when sample rate <5% hide the p95 overlay by default and show a prominent inline warning: "Low sample rate — increase sampling or enable full traces for accurate p95".
Janet: Accessibility nit: ensure the overlay toggle has a visible focus ring and `aria-label="Toggle p95 visibility"`. Keyboard-only users should be able to toggle and focus the legend entry.
Sam: I'll mock keyboard interactions + updated figma states tonight and post a link. Maya, Alex — can you review the figma after 8pm PST?
Maya: Yup, will check after dinner. :thumbsup:
Alex: Sounds good. Thanks — Sam.
